responses.body:
Connect CoinGecko

To generate a tax report, historical prices are required. CoinGecko free plan covers up to 2 years of history. For older transactions, upgrade to CoinGecko Analyst or join deltabadger.com where market data is included.

CoinGecko API Key

How to get API keys from CoinGecko

  1. Sign up to CoinGecko
  2. Go to API section
  3. Press Get Your API Key Now
  4. Create Free Account is below the pricing
  5. Fill the form
  6. Press Create API key
  7. Copy API key and paste it above
